notes.title: 1.2 Coming Soon, Patch, and Cloud Saves
notes.content:
The Steam cloud saves finally work on MacOS! It should also be working cross-platform as well. The backup-save system we made is still in place as well, in case there are more trouble ahead.

This is a smaller patch, in preparation for 1.2, adding a few more suggestions and fixing some bugs. 

[h2]1.1.1 Changelog:[/h2][p]
[list]
[*] Steam cloud saves should now work on all platforms!
[*] Chess pieces now avoid moving behind the Grandmaster
[*] Added a toggle to use a 2D Planet, for any players having graphical issues with the 3d planet model.
[*] Tweaked some of the encounter generation to avoid bad encounters.
[*] Combo now resets at the start of your turn for better timing with the Time Angel.
[*] Fixed Toy Bomb previews with Red Giant
[*] Added missing tags for Nova Control
[*] Fixed Bash and Last Resort not counting as "push" cards
[*] Fixed invisible cursor on rewinding
[*] Fixed sometimes the artifact reward on the globe scene goes out of the screen with the steam deck
[*] Fixed Jab upgraded cards not counting as "random" cards
[*] Fixed Quick Restart with the daily run creating too many modifiers
[*] Fixed missing localization for Regenerating Shield
[*] Fixed Discard Pile number not matching when playing with Pickups
[*] Throw Junk achievement now triggers correctly with more types of throws
[*] Attempted improvements to performance across the board.
[*] Fixed French localization not working in the Mac build.
[/list]

Since we've been working in parallel on the update, some of the fixes for a few extra known bug reports (such as the bestiary issues) will be fixed in 1.2, coming at the end of the month.

[h1]September 29 - Night of the Invaders[/h1]

We're about the begin the beta for 1.2 in our discord server this week or next week, come join and check out the new content! The public release is planned to be September 29th, to coincide with the Steam Autumn Festival.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/5a041f2c3138258de9dfc9f55c4550ff2ba7322d.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Are those new invaders???[/i][/p][p][/p][p]

[b]1.2 - Night of the Invaders[/b] will include:

- 6 new invaders! (with their basic and advanced variants)

- Full Moon Pack: A pack that plays with [i]Sacrifice[/i] and [i]Isolated[/i] invaders.

- Academy Pack: A pack that focuses on manipulating [i]Starter Cards[/i]. 

- A bunch of new achievements!

Things are speeding up for the rest of the year. The next update after that (1.3) will be coming sooner than later (November 21st!). We'll be starting the beta for that one in October. 

We hope everyone enjoyed their summer vacations! The team took some good time off as well, but now we're all back to work. There's some exciting things coming ahead - stay tuned!

[i]- Axolotl of the Pengonauts

notes.title: Update 1.1 Teaser & Beta Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Hey pilots! Hope you are all doing well!

It's been exactly 1 month since our full release and we've been so happy to see the response from you all! A lot of gratitude for all the feedback and reviews you have left us, they've helped tremendously.

Following that, we're excited to announce that the game is doing well enough for us to continue improving it and adding more content with free updates, starting with the 1.1 update coming in [strike]two[/strike] a few weeks!   [/p][h2]Update 1.1: Coming Soon![/h2][p]
We've been pretty busy during release month fixing a lot of the major bugs and crashes that have been reported, but now that things have stabilized a bit better we will be slowling down our rate of patching to work on bigger content updates.

Here are some of the planned new content that will be available in the 1.1 update:

[/p][h3]Sandbox Settings:[/h3][p]
We've added a bunch of customization features since release based on player feedback (such as save-scum mode for example). To expand on that, I've decided to create a whole menu for more customization of the game. 

Included in the new sandbox settings will be new options inspired by player feedback such as:

- Add more granular post-Apocalypse challenges with smaller steps in between each difficulty.
- Post-Apoc no longer shortens each act.
- Ban specific bosses from appearing (great for achievement hunting!)
- More...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/61080667b692c6d08974dee967ad096b3e1a7d2b.png"][/img][i]Did someone say they want more ascensions??[/i]

Just to make it clear, the DEFAULT difficulties will not change, but we will be adding new options to customize the difficulty for players.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/bd8b1e180cb8bae9296f4e53ddbe6c65fdbbb33d.png"][/img]
I'm personally pretty open to allow players to play the game the way they want to play, so if it's not too hard to implement I don't mind adding new options based on suggestions! Let us know what you'd like to be able to customize in game.

[/p][h3]New Cards and Artifacts:[/h3][p]
There will be a new, summer-themed neutral pack, as well as new pilot-unique common artifacts for each pilot! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/b44c2a85816d739acca75a0a3aa2c8f126246594.png"][/img][i]Vamos a la playa![/i]

I should warn that the new card pack might be based on a potentially controversial mechanic haha, but at least with the Sandbox Settings you'll be able to ban specific packs from appearing too, so if you don't like the new pack you can disable them from in-game!

[/p][h3]Beta Build[/h3][p]
We will be opening up a beta build (probably on Monday) to start playtesting the 1.1 update. More information about that will be shared on our Discord and QQ groups. The beta will also only be available in English and Chinese.

Starting from now, we will also likely be pushing updates and the usual patches to the beta first, before updating the main build. That should prevent some of those awkward hot-fixes for crashes i accidently introduce in the last minute, oopsie.

[/p][h2]Other Additional Notes[/h2][p]
[/p][h3]Steam Cloud Saves for Mac...[/h3][p]
We've tried to enable steam cloud-saves a couple times for Mac for the past few weeks, but everytime we did it, Steam decides it's ok to delete the entire save directory [i]without warning[/i], deleting all progress from Mac users. 

We've even implemented a backup folder that is seperate from the steam cloud specified directory to avoid this specific problem, but apparently that entire backup folder gets deleted by Steam cloud too even though it's not in the path that steam cloud is supposed to update... So for now we've disabled Steam cloud saves for Mac and are waiting on a solution from Steam Support so that we can enable it without deleting any progress.

[/p][h3]Optimization Issues[/h3][p]
We've also gotten your reports on optimization issues, potentially some sort of memory leak as well on long playtimes. We haven't quite figured it out yet, but are working on it. 

If you are experiencing strange amounts of lag or stutterring, please use the in-game bug report form if possible to send us a report! That'll help us figure out the cause, thanks!

[/p][h2]Thanks for everything - Pengonauts[/h2][p]
A huge thanks again for everyone. To wrap up this too-long news post, we wanted to highlight a few of the content creators that have believed in us, as well as some of the amazing fan-art created by the community so far! Check it out:

notes.title: 1.0.7 - Fixer Upper
notes.content:
[strike]UPDATE - I'm rolling back this update for today, there's a critical bug for new bootups. Will update when we figure out what's going on. Sorry about that! [/strike] 

UPDATE - Update is live again!


More bug fixes! And we've reworked some of the Hemophage as well. 

[h2]Hemophage 2.0[/h2]

Based on feedback we're smoothening out some of the awkward parts of the Hemophage, and allowing more options to deal with it so it's not a pain to fight.

[list]
[*] No longer becomes Immune while splitting (you can keep hitting it with repeated cards to deal more damage, but it will split into more Hemocytes)
[*] In the "Final phase", no longer recombines with Hemocytes and only keeps 1 HP.
[*] Added more text for describe the Hemocytes.
[*] Reduced total HP again.
[*] Delayed attacks (like Titan Rocket or Auto-Bombs) now correctly trigger before the Hemophage absorbs its Hemocytes.
[/list]


[h2]Other:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with our save backup system, wasn't working for certain OS versions.
[*] Fixed bug where you reload into an empty hand
[*] Fixed bug where some boss timers don't show up
[*] Repeated self-drop cards now keep their rarity (like Claw Trap)
[*] Pilot Album now unlocks correctly with Daily or Challenge wins
[*] Fixed Sygyzy counting twice for Xenn's Relic
[*] Fixed a couple softlock involving skipping cutscenes
[*] Fixed a softlock involving pressing mutliple buttons at once during unlocks
[*] Fixed Old Comet, now doesn't trigger when played.
[*] Fixed bug where Nessie stops moving.
[*] Nessie now heals the tile directly in front of it each turn on Phase 2.
[*] Fixed bugs where Nessie's attack isn't correctly displayed when rerolling during an attack
[*] Fixed generation error where you reroll into the same encounters at the start of an act.
[*] Fixed True Ending working with dailies or challenge on Mac
[*] Fixed Boss room not appearing if you have too many relics
[*] Fixed Eclipse not ending when there are no more waves or enemies. (Eclipse now also ends early if there are only Echos left on its turn)
[*] Fixed Task Engine crash involving repeated Raise Army on Bombs with Blast Legion
[*] Fixed timer not showing up on pause/resu,e
[*] Bombs with Blast Legion can no longer be stealth charged (to trigger Charge Fire).
[*] Fixed visual bug where the Overseer fight is warped
[*] Fixed Witch Fire counting cooldown of destroyed spells.
[*] Made Death by a Thousand Cuts achievement count one less repeat (because it was confusing that you needed to see 11x in game)
[*] Fixed softlock by getting stuck in Pause Menu on a screen outside of a run
[*] Many localization changes
[/list]


Keep the bug reports coming! Thanks! 

- Axolotl of the Pengonauts

notes.title: 1.0.6 - Call for Backup!
notes.content:
More bug fixes and a new backup system for save files - in preparation for enabling Cloud Save for Mac. 

We're almost done with all the major reported bugs! There's a few things we're struggling with (looking at you performance issues), but we're making progress.

[h2]Save File Backup System:[/h2]

We implemented a backup system that will backup your progress (unlocks, achievements, etc), so that if you lose your main save file, the game will automatically grab from the backup file and restore your progress.

This is in anticipation of enabling Steam Cloud saves for Mac, because Steam WILL delete your save files without warning. 

In 1 or 2 weeks we will enable Steam Cloud saves on Mac, so [b]if you are on a Mac, you should definitely play at least once on this patch to make sure your unlock progress will be saved. [/b] You will likely lose your run history and any on-going run, so please do backup those if they matter to you!

[h2]Other:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added optional True Ending to the Daily Run and ALL Challenges
[*] Fixed softlock when you press Random in the character select and go back from Stinger
[*] Fixed Supporter Pack not working on Mac
[*] Stayin' Alive achievement now works with 5 Doom
[*] Fixed Jinx missing a Push tag
[*] Fixed task engine crash involving Mudslide 
[*] Fixed True Ending Phase 2 resetting Mana if you have more than the max
[*] Fixed task engine crash with a Void Spawn + Blast Legion interaction
[*] Fixed running out of spells during Spell Reward (actually fixed this time)
[*] Fixed skip same cutscene twice leading to bad transition
[*] Fixed Nessie being messed up by savescum / SL mode
[*] Fixed Hemophage HP bar dissapearing on exit and resume
[*] Fixed crash when clicking deck on exit Min's
[*] Fixed crash when clicking pack on exit Bud's
[*] Fixed certain preview "ghosts" appearing floating in the air next to the display panel (like Turret)
[*] Upscaled barks, tutorial tips and trophies for better readability on Steam Deck.
[*] Upscaled several controller glyphs for better readability
[*] Attempted fix on some of the resolution errors on widescreen
[*] Many localization changes
[/list]

I will also start a BETA branch soon for our first "big" update (1.1) that will come out this summer - stay tuned!

- Axolotl of the Pengonauts

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Roxy's Revenge
notes.content:
[b]First up, a warning: IF YOU ARE PLAYING ON MAC, BACKUP YOUR SAVE FILES. We will be adding Steam Cloud support to Mac soon, but are unsure how it will affect the game if you played on multiple devices. Our apologies if something happens to them! 

For anyone looking for save files for the MAC version. It's at "/Users/USERNAME/Library/Application Support/com.Pengonauts.StarVaders".[/b]

---

Hope you all had a great weekend! Got some great feedback from a very wide range of types of players, they've all been super useful! We're only 3 people on the team (2 programmers and 1 artist), so it will take some time to fix everything, but we're hard at work! 

Here are some of the notable changes in this patch:

[h1]Roxy's New Starting Deck[/h1]

[list]
[*] 5x Shift 
[*] 2x Fire!
[*] 2x Triple Fire!
[*] 1x Nova Bomb
[/list]
Roxy is the weakest pilot on higher difficulties, but her deck is great to introduce the game with - so what I did was keep the tutorial deck the same, but changed her deck after the tutorial run. Gunner struggles a lot because of their weaker movement, so I brought Triple Fire! into her starting deck as an extra AOE option that can target further invaders. 

[h1]Vengoid+[/h1]

Vengoid+ now moves erratically, instead of giving Shields.

Vengoid Plus is one of the hardest invaders to deal with in Post-Apocalypse +, there's not a lot of time nor leeway to deal with them and the Shield makes it much more tedious to fight against. Shield was a boring ability anyway! Erratic movement now challenges the player in a slightly different way while still keeping the identity.

[h1]Hemophage[/h1]

Hemophage fight has been quite confusing and difficult for a lot of players, and a very long fight as well. We've cut down their health pool, updated their description, and added more visual indicators to be more clear that the "purple" hemocytes should be destroyed since those are the ones that will channel doom. To balance this change, we've also shortened the turn limit.

[h1]True Ending Fixes and Improvements[/h1]

[Spoiler] The Overseer fight for the True Ending can occasionally be a big pain point for players, particularly if it's the first time they encounter it - it doesn't help that the transitions are kinda badly implemented timing-wise. I've made changes to address some of the issues: [/spoiler]

[list]
[*] [spoiler](from patch 1.0.3) You now draw 3 cards and reset energy on phase 1 -> 2 transition. [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]On each phase transition, you now keep all your puppets. (If they were in the "head" zone, they move to the bottom side of the grid)[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]The "Assist" cards that drop as pickups to help on the final turn have a glowing visual indicator now.[/spoiler]

Hello Pilots,

It's launch week! So meet Sura - Our next Keeper Pilot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/28292dcbaebc2f892fb7308ac61d18bb191138c0.png[/img]

[b]Name:[/b] Sura

[b]Place of Birth:[/b] An ungoverned corner of earth

As a result, their family quickly judged that they would be more of a burden than a boon, and so the two were abandoned at a young age and left to fend for themselves in the world.

To make a living for themselves, they became performers. Their trust was so strong, that together they could accomplish feats that others could not even with all of their senses.

notes.title: Meet the Pilots: Iris
notes.content:

Compared to the Gunner and Stinger, the Keeper plays differently on the battlefield --Instead of a typical Mech, the Keeper possesses the entities it can summon! Weave powerful spells and use your summons to your advantage!

[b]Name:[/b] Iris

[b]Place of Birth:[/b] Irkutsk Zone 3-LR

[b]Bio:[/b] Thrust into a motherly role from a young age, Iris grew up as one of the older kids in an orphanage. She spent her days helping the orphanage's director, a kind man named Qasim, and playing with the younger children there. 

However, one child's anger resulted in a devastating explosion causing a huge fire. Qasim rushed in to save as many children as he could but found himself buried under the debris. Iris tried her best to lift him out but wasn't able to save him. He ordered her to leave him and look after the children.

In the aftermath of the accident, Iris is covered in burns but still alive. notes.title: Happy New Year from Noel
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,

Happy New Year, it's launch year for StarVaders and we're super excited for the months ahead! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/600d3324e9ccd5f0afdec8d8ff3c9b7db04d64ba.png[/img]

[i][h3]"Stay cool Noel, remember what's at stake."[/h3][/i]

[h3]Pilot Bio[/h3]

[b]Name:[/b] Noel

[b]Place of Birth:[/b] Antarctic Settlement (Approximately 20km from Nuclear Crater)  

[b]Bio:[/b] Despite living near the nuclear crater, a relic of the Extinction War, life was relatively worry-free for Noel and her younger sister, Eira. They were accustomed to seeing Mechas from an early age as they worked to insulate the colossal icebergs that the people of Antarctica called home.

However, it wasn't long before a strange illness emerged. At first, the symptoms were hailed as the next stage in human evolution, allowing those afflicted to drain the heat from nearby objects with a simple gesture. But this supposed blessing wouldn't last forever. Over time, their bodies would be unable to retain heat, eventually freezing them where they stood. The unlucky ones affected became known as 'The Frozen'.

Noel manifested her powers at 24 years old, just as she was finishing her studies in biomedical sciences. With her future being stolen from her, Noel struggled with her place in the world, resigning herself to her fate. It wasn't until her sister developed the same symptoms two years later that Noel dedicated whatever remaining time she has left to research her illness and find a solution.

When the invasion began, Noel was prepared to defend her Antarctic homeland, but also had an ulterior motive to study the aliens in the hopes of finding something to help cure herself and her sister.

[h3]Bring the Perma-Frost[/h3]

Noel's illness offers her a range of unique tactical moves on the battlefield. Ice projectiles have a devastating effect on enemy units with the added bonus of providing some home comforts from Noel's Antarctic homeland. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/72ecb0b13b915763ba9cda3ff06fab9be6712382.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Perma-Frost [/b]- Your rightmost card is unburnt and becomes [i]Frozen [/i]when your turn ends
[*] [b]Cold Star[/b] - When the encounter begins, gives [i]Frozen[/i] to 2 random cards in your hand. Your Frozen cards count as Burnt cards, and vice-versa.
[*] [b]Iceberg[/b] - When your turn begins, make Frozen cards in your hand free.
[/list]

[i]Frozen[/i] cards are Noel's specialty. They aren't discarded when a turn ends so can be queued up for maximum effect.

Like with all our pilots, having unique artifacts and cards really helps build diversity during your runs. Noel has some interesting cards like [b]Cold Snap[/b] which strikes a random invader but does additional strikes for each Frozen card you own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/0b84678f9c6f749caee20e75dc2c9a80dc0ea1f6.png[/img]

And then there's [b]Chisel[/b] - A tactical card that discards a card from your deck but adds two new cards. And if you choose to discard one of your frozen cards, then both new cards are free to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/751a2986bd5c3dc4f0ef563cac1ef79d4c4c916f.png[/img]

That's all for Noel just now, but you can discover more of her unique cards as you play and we'll be back with another Pilot feature soon!

Wishing you all the best for 2025!

The Pengonauts Team

[h3]Pilot Bio[/h3]

[b]Name:[/b] Roxy

[b]Place of Birth:[/b] 31st Northwestern Sahara Settlement

[b]Bio:[/b] Roxy's parents worked as moon miners, often leaving Roxy at home for months at a time. Her earlier years were spent looking up at the stars, hoping to one day join them on their adventures. That day would sadly not come to pass, when she was 16 news of a tragic mining accident reached her settlement.

In the aftermath, her mom's damaged mecha was the only thing that was returned to her. Being the last physical remaining connection to her parents, Roxy tinkered with the mech night and day while her community supported her. 

When the aliens invaded, Roxy's engineering skills made her one of the first to be called upon to strike back against the invaders. She'll do anything to protect her world and the people of the 31st.

[h3]A True Firestarter[/h3]

Guns, missiles, explosives - Roxy is no stranger to these weapons, and utilises her Gunner Mech to unleash devastating attacks on her foes but she also has a few unique artifacts that give her an advantage in the field (if used correctly).

From Roxy artifacts, you may be able to get a feel for what strategies would work best for her. By pushing the limits of her Gunner Mech, she can use overheating to her advantage and wreck havoc on the battlefield.

notes.title: 0.7 - NEMESIS Update
notes.content:
This year is gonna be an insane year for us. (and most likely the release year?)

We definitely skipped the demo versions 0.6, but that's because those updates mostly added new systems to the beta - Now we're back with 0.7 with a changelog that doesn't even fit in a single steam post! 


Let's get straight to the point:

[h1]What's new in 0.7?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/318ed3b7b6c2f3131e2881372bff0983eea4758f.png[/img]

[h2]2 New Bosses, 5 New Invaders! ​[/h2]

We've almost doubled the content of the demo! Fight the mysterious Shambler in act 1, and defeat the very chessy Grandmaster in act 3!

The rest of the invaders are slowly unlocked as you play the game - but they will change things up quite a bit! The Virus adds negative components to your cards and the Fallen Angel let's you trade Doom for Stars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/0e4203d94121396d02d5c89de1e2081344200760.gif[/img] 

[h2]We've listened to the feedback![/h2]

Of course we always listen to the feedback, but many of the major topics that come up have been finally been completely taken care of:

- [b]Better Tutorial (again)[/b]: Tutorials are hard! We've remade the tutorial again to be even clearer, and also now added a quick guide for anyone who skips the tutorial or needs a quick reminder!

- [b]Doom System[/b]: Slightly reworked to improve the pacing and challenge of the game, with more interesting decision making involved with reducing Doom as well.

- [b]Skippable Repeats and Moves[/b]: You can now skip repeats with selections and moves that could be otherwise detrimental for you! We're giving even more control to the player.

- [b]Improved Upgrades[/b]: We've realized with your help that the upgrade system wasn't reaching its full potential - so I've redesigned a lot of upgrades, and added new artifacts with a focus on making it feel like upgrades are an even more significant factor in how the player crafts their build.

- [b]You can now push invaders out of the "Doom zone" to stop them from channelling Doom[/b]: This was probably one of the most requested feature haha, but we've figured out a way to get it to work intuitively without breaking any of the more advanced invader designs!

... and more!

[h2]Some of the craziest Deckbuilder QoL you've ever seen![/h2]

- [b]Context-Relevant Previews[/b]: Whenever you pick a card or artifact, you'll see the relevant cards in your deck!

- [b]Guaranteed Draw Previews[/b]: Whenever you draw cards (and its a guaranteed hit), it will show you what you draw!

- [b]Artifact Trigger Previews[/b]: Whenever a card-related artifact triggers, it will show up on the card itself as a big reminder!

- [b]Deck Preview[/b]: Hover over your deck or discard pile to see what's in it!

- [b]Better Enemy Panels[/b]: Enemies now tell you how much doom and stars they make!

... and more...

[h3] And much more! The changelog is so massive it literally doesn't fit in this steam post, If you're really curious, all the changes are written progressively in our beta channel on our discord![/h3]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

LOCALIZATION! We're about to localize the demo into many, many languages. I'm super excited to bring the game to other parts of the world and excited to get more feedback as well!

We are also starting some big activities and participating in quite a few upcoming festivals soon - spread the hype! We won't be in the february next fest though, but our demo and beta is not going anywhere!

This year will be HUGE for us, and I am so happy to have all of your support to help our team thrive! Can't announce anything more - but do stay tuned!

In the meantime, if you're starving for more content, please join [url=https://discord.gg/bEETNGyGVE]our Discord server[/url] and request access to our beta! We are still testing the second mech and difficulty levels in our closed beta, with some crazy new content on the way too!

Although this is likely the one of the biggest Demo update we've ever had, it is still a rather "small" content update, most of the changes are mechanical changes, or QoL features. [h3]- ​​Updated Visuals! ​[/h3]

Added animations for all simple invaders in the game, and a new card shader too! We're planning to have animations for most entities in the game, and are still working on adding more.

[h3]- Even Better Pilots![/h3]

We've updated the two pilots to truly have unique mechanics. Noel now plays with her unique *Frozen* card mechanic, while Zeke's deck has been simplified to make it smoother to play.

The pilots also now have unique cards and artifacts they can find in their card pool to support their new archetypes! (Even Roxy has new, unique cards!) You can click on the "Loadout" when selecting pilots and scroll down to check out what they have! (We're still working on the Glossary).

[h1]What's next? (delay)[/h1]

We will unfortunately *not* be participating in the October Next Fest, and will also not be releasing into EA this year. We're still having discussions, but we're trying to make sure the game is in the best state possible and have enough time to market the game before it comes out!

[h1]What's new in 0.4?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/5f53c8174a600b8c53f7f612efa0efc7c3aa91c8.png[/img]

[h3]- ​​Updated Tutorial! ​[/h3]

Meet Tippy, who will explain the mechanics of the game in a more user-friendly and clearer way than before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/a19b145db40aca1835b95381f4ec8c4aba709629.png[/img]

[h3]- Metaprogression Systems![/h3]

After you finish a run (that is far enough), you'll meet a strange new character that will help you unlock more content in the game! On top of that, we've updated the way we handle unlocks for Pilots, and created a new Mech XP system that lets you unlock new cards and artifacts! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/afa459766e9b677f90aabe25378afae851cb09ad.png[/img]

You'll now be able to see your Run History and score in a new scene! We're gonna be adding more features to it in the future, but for now it includes your deck, score, time played, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/6440fe470db2a4a591980fae8eb04f37a18f0a75.png[/img]

We've updated the visuals for the More Info scene, Victory and Defeat scenes, and the Main Menu! This is part of our on-going rework of all the scenes in the game. We're still working on the Deck view, Glossary, and the settings menu as well!

The new More Info scene let's you check out the AOE for some of the weirder cards like Flamethrower, as well as a new button that let's you check out all the possible components a card could get.

Other than patch fixes and balance updates, we won't be doing as many major updates as we prepare for our EA release sometime near the end of the year! The next major update you can expect will be the Next Fest update, which will also be the last update for the demo - that update will bring the remainder of the visual upgrades, as well as add animations to the game! (the grid entities will all be animated)

notes.title: Prototype 0.3 - Reinforcements!
notes.content:
[h2]​Hi Steam![/h2]

[b]Thank you so much for checking out our game![/b] 

We've gathered over 2000 wishlists now and over a hundred followers! Thanks so much for all the feedback and enthusiam!

Download the [url=https://starvaders.itch.io/starvaders]demo on itch.io over here[/url], and check out what's new!


[h1]What's new in 0.3?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/fafaa3b3ba64509bc2cd3bf10a70ebe356e3fa03.png[/img]

[h3]- ​​2 NEW Pilots! ​[/h3]

We've promised 1 new pilot, but spent a bit more time to add 2 new pilots for the Gunner mech class! Pilots are characters that have a new starter artifact and starter cards - to spice things up each time you play! Their mechanics will be unique, and make you able to do combos and synergies that cannot exist with any other pilot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/b38a7b6a45f7b3189161ede936891fa1b994b91f.png[/img]

[h3]- Noel - the Cool Headed Tactician![/h3]

Noel is the second pilot in the game. Her starter artifact called Perma-Frost lets her [b]retain the rightmost card in her hand each turn - and unburn it![/b] Her starter cards replacements are Flurry Fire! and Novalanche - unique twists on the classic starters. She can easily lean into burn synergies, build up epic combos of Flurries in Fire! synergy, or devastate the board with bombs with Novalanche. Her starter artifact lets her do some nifty things such as - 

- A Chain Plasma Fire that never leaves your hand? 
- Repeat your turns indefinitely by unburning Alpha/Beta/Gamma?
- Setup huge hard-synergy combos by retaining exactly what you need at the right moments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/7461fb911d31a00c8cb54d2a245e3384eb256964.png[/img]

[h3]- Zeke - the Gadgeteering Genius![/h3]

Zeke is the third, high complexity pilot for Gunner. His starter artifact is The Machine, which [b]dismantles cards with Components to give you boosts![/b] He does not start with new starter cards, but starts with Augment, as well as Downgrade Components on some of his Fires and his Nova Bomb! Break down his downgrades and boost up his other cards in a tactical and adaptive playstyle! Here's some of the potential builds you could make with only Zeke:

- Infinite Titan Rockets or Tornado? Dismantle creates a new copy of the base card, regardless of if the card purges itself or not!
- Dismantle Tactics to get Vapor and build a high Heat Sink build with the updated Furnace!
- Did you know double-Traited cards will give you two gadgets if you dismantle them? 

[h3]​- New artifacts, reworks, balance changes, and more QOL improvements! [/h3]

Thank you so much for your feedback and comments, it's being so useful! If you do have more feedback, [url=https://discord.gg/bEETNGyGVE]please join our Discord​​ and let us know![/url]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

​For our 0.4 update, we are focusing on fixing up the remainder of the scenes, and reworking the tutorial. Or more specifically, we will be reworking the tutorial so that it ties into the meta-progression as part of one big clean progression system. It is not a content-focused update, but we will still be adding cards, artifacts, components to the game as always!

notes.title: Prototype 0.2 - Mars Attacks!
notes.content:
[h2]​Heya everyone![/h2]

[b]Thank you so much for playing our game![/b] 

Since our first demo release, we've got content creators who found our game, reached over 1000 wishlists, and gathered over 1200 downloads in under a month! So today I'm super excited to announce that update [b]0.2: Mars Attacks![/b] is now released. 

Download the [url=https://starvaders.itch.io/starvaders]demo on itch.io over here[/url], and check out what's new!


[h1]What's new since 0.1?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/77a90f8f28cb113c172b6939b9e3e844fd6c3450.png[/img]

[h3]- ​​4 new invaders, 1 new special encounter! ​[/h3]

[b]We've added the Vengoid, Spitter, Leviathan, and Voidspawn invaders![/b] These new invaders challenge your tactical senses and introduce new mechanics for you to learn and overcome. You'll find them across all 3 acts, adding to the exponential variety of battlefields you can encounter! 

[h3]- 5 new cards, 3 new artifacts, and 5 new components![/h3]

We've introduced new cards that enable legendary ways to play with the Burn, Junk and Fire! archetypes. 0.2 adds a new utility card to the fan-favorite Bomb archetype! Find and plan for huge explosions with the new [b]Detonator[/b] card!

​Find the [b]Jester, Furnace[/b], and the legendary [b]​Big Fridge[/b] ​​artifacts that change the way you play with the game! The ​Big Fridge​​ sets ALL of your cards' Heat cost to 1 when you play them (Overclock says hi!). 

There's also 3 new basic components and 2 new secret components! One of the new basic components is the [b]Linked[/b] ​component, which, when played, also immediately plays ALL other ​Linked​ cards in your hand or draw pile for free. How many cards do you think you can you link to each other in your deck?

[h3]- Improved tutorial, a Glossary, and a bunch of visual updates![/h3]

The tutorial is now a lot friendlier, with a nerfed Mothership and better scripted card rewards - getting into the game is smoother than ever. (and we are still planning on reworking the whole tutorial soon!) The [b]Glossary[/b] lets players check out all the different cards and artifacts that they might have missed while playing! It's a theory crafter's dream.​

[h3]​- 70+ Bugfixes, balance updates, and QoL improvements! [/h3]

​We've fixed almost all the bugs that have been reported to us! (almost because there's a few very sneaky ones we're still working on >:( ) Thank you so much for your feedback and comments, it's being so useful! If you do have more feedback, [url=https://discord.gg/bEETNGyGVE]please join our Discord​​ and let us know![/url]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

​For our 0.3 update, we're gonna be working on meta-progression, a mech selection screen, as well as a new pilot for you to play with! The full game will have multiple classes of mechs with distinct card pools and mechanics. But each mech class will have multiple pilots as well! Pilots will share card pools, but have different starter cards and artifacts that change the way you play the game. As always, there will be new cards, artifacts, components, bugfixes, etc, too!
